name: masmax-streaming-platform
description: Catalogo web demo de streaming con React, NestJS, PostgreSQL y Prisma.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/backend" "npm run dev --workspace apps/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/backend && npm run build --workspace apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/backend && npm run lint --workspace apps/frontend

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/backend && npm run test --workspace apps/frontend
